# bugs #3879: Internal error in SDCCopt.c for a member of a union in a struct at a literal address

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3879/
- Category: [Already fixed in trunk](../../fixed-upstream.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17158
- Recommended action: Close as fixed in r15798, the fix for bug #3894.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The reduced case in the ticket's first comment and the original `CAN_TypeDef` case compile without
an error on r17158. For mcs51 this was checked with the small, large, and huge models, with
`--stack-auto`, and with `--opt-code-size` and `--opt-code-speed`. Thirteen variations of the
construct were also compiled for mcs51, and the generated code addresses the correct bytes. The
variations cover `__xdata`, `__idata`, `__code`, and generic pointer casts, a struct inside the
union, reads, writes, `|=`, `++`, and the address-of operator.

## Fixed by

[r15798](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/15798/), the fix for bug #3894, which reports the same
construct. For `((S *)0x8000)->Un.B` the front end emits two pointer additions with offset 0.
`optimizeCastCast` in `src/SDCCopt.c` combines the two additions, and the literal becomes the left
operand of the second addition. Before r15798 the function then applied `OP_USES` to that literal,
which is the internal error in the ticket. r15798 guards the `bitVectSetBit` call with
`IS_SYMOP (uic->left)`. The code path is the same for every port.
